title: Crash after claiming an email can permanently suppress lifecycle and trial-grace delivery

reviewers: blind AI reviewer, pass 1 (six Claude subagents, one per batch)
aiReview.rationale: The report's sequence holds: sendBundle and TrialGraceEmails.sendDue commit the lifecycleEmailLog claim before sending and roll it back only in-process, so a crash leaves a row treated as delivered with no lease or reclaim; usage-limit flags are persisted before the send and a rejected send is only logged.
